title: Start a lane worktree in one call: krn lane start prints the ready path
body:
Outcome: `krn lane start <slug>` fetches origin/main, creates the branch and worktree under .krn/worktrees, and prints the path and branch in one call.
Why: .krn/runs/roadmap-refill-4/report.md: `git worktree add` was 126 turns ($9.8, 93 of 99 sessions) and fetch/checkout another 98 turns ($6.0), about 2 turns per merged PR, each re-typing the lanes.md recipe.
Proof: test creates a worktree and rejects a duplicate slug in a temp repo; rerun p.py on 30 new sessions: worktree add + fetch turns below 1 per PR.
Scope: src/ CLI command and test, lanes.md first bullet.
